correctness_plan.kernel_gate: Separate root-owned GPU gate validates all supported shapes/dtypes/padding and graph replay against independent CPU oracle.

numerical_tolerance.origin: Historical BF16 layer diagnostic thresholds; fixed before new GPU results

correctness_plan.scope_limit: Selected-layer arithmetic plus all-layer weight identity does not establish complete-model numerical equivalence or performance. Timed runs disable diagnostics and restart.
correctness_plan.startup_diagnostic: Optional correctness-only config: all48 layers/fullBF16 weights and7680 physical expert instances;1536 duplicate logical-layer experts hash equal; layers0/23/47 compare resident and local-native-hash physical assignments/native expert outputs/directFP32 on three cases.

implementation_state: implemented locally; CPU tests pass; full-model GPU diagnostics pending

insertion_points.finding: Native top-k computes logical IDs and weights locally, then applies EPLB physical mapping. Resident mode sets eplb_state=None so IDs remain logical and no mapping/recording kernel runs.
supports_internal_mk is true when the unquantized method builds its internal kernel; therefore the runner does not gather router logits before routing in this active path.

Native prepare gathers hidden states, top-k IDs and weights. Resident mapping is inserted after native prepare returns globally gathered IDs, preserving hidden/scales/metadata/weights and native finalize.
AgRs dispatch all-gathers tensors in rank order; combine reduce-scatters back to the original DP sizes. DP inputs are distinct, not replicated-layer harness inputs.
Gather output shape is (sum(per-rank padded sizes), top_k); torch.empty output is contiguous and retains input dtype. Mapper checks shape/dtype/layout/device.
Padded rows get -1 route indices. V2 persistent is_padding buffers are updated per step and used by captured graphs. Gathered padding is not generally a single suffix.

Native checkpoint mapping uses the same initial physical-to-logical builder as EPLB state. The plugin replaces this builder before loading, so each physical slot loads its declared logical expert directly, without migration.
V2 prepare_load runs before model construction; maybe_register_model runs after weights load and before worker profile/graph capture. This is the binding/diagnostic hook.

Plugin bypasses native state construction, model state registration, async startup, forward metadata updates and step. A native-state constructor guard fails closed if any unsupported path attempts recurring EPLB state.
Supported general plugins load before worker-class initialization in every worker. Local dist-info metadata on PYTHONPATH provides discovery without changing venv packages.

legacy_port_limits.old_mapper: resident_residual prebound mapper is hardcoded EP2/B128/top8 and constructing stream; it is not reused for dynamic full-model graphs. New mapper is separately validated.
legacy_port_limits.unchanged_map_shortcut: No recurring candidate, movement or commit exists in fixed-resident mode, so the old unchanged-map shortcut has no active work to intercept. No claim of an async unchanged-map port is made.

padding_and_graph_contract.allocation: Immutable setup metadata and per-call capturable output tensors; no reused single-stream B128 scratch buffers
padding_and_graph_contract.logical_ids: contiguous int32/int64 [T,8], T <= 65536; native -1 sentinels preserved, count only valid0..127 IDs
padding_and_graph_contract.selection: After native gather for resident; before gather for native-hash placement-only diagnostic

placement.change_from_native: Native ON retains its original contiguous [0..127,0..31] map. Custom comparison includes this explicit balanced placement and resident selection.
placement.frozen_from: Topology and model geometry only, no pilot/final routing outcomes
placement.per_rank: 16 original experts + first four experts of partner rank

supporting_cpp_source.runtime_guard: Python sources checked; compiled native padding behavior must pass GPU diagnostic
